notes: Use 'eindigen' when something comes to a natural end or completion. It is often intransitive, meaning it happens to the subject itself.
Do not confuse this with 'stoppen'. 'Stoppen' usually means to cease an action you are currently doing (like stopping your work), whereas 'eindigen' refers to the termination of the process itself.
